problem: BeBee needs a legible garden loop: a home hub with a deterministic portal chain, small route-based zones, readable fenced flower pens, pleasant feedback, non-punitive threats, and meaningful Honey sinks without increasing save or bundle risk.

decision.rationale: The selected loop combines APICO's short tactile cadence, Alba's compact task spaces, Garden Story's restoration plus optional pressure, and Pikmin 4's route planning while preserving BeBee's existing movement-through-pollination verb and v4 save contract.

selected_references.name: APICO / tactile care cadence
selected_references.selection_reason: Closest interaction cadence to short bee-care actions.
selected_references.observed_behavior: Official positioning centers beekeeping and flower work as hands-on activities.
selected_references.inference: BeBee should use short, distinct route and pollination beats.

selected_references.name: Alba / compact task spaces
selected_references.selection_reason: Supports compact zones with a clear current purpose.
selected_references.observed_behavior: Official positioning centers a small island wildlife adventure and concrete tasks.
selected_references.inference: BeBee should expose one active zone at a time.

selected_references.name: Garden Story / restoration and pressure
selected_references.observed_behavior: Official positioning combines community restoration with adventure challenges.
selected_references.inference: Pests should add atmosphere and route tension without lethal failure.

selected_references.name: Pikmin 4 / route challenge nodes
selected_references.selection_reason: Uses traversal planning as a lightweight challenge.
selected_references.observed_behavior: Official positioning highlights exploration, obstacles, and challenge spaces.
selected_references.inference: Three ordered beacons can gate pollination without adding a new combat verb.

selected_references.name: Strange Horticulture / readable plant identity
selected_references.selection_reason: Reinforces explicit naming and visible object/state pairing.
selected_references.observed_behavior: Official positioning emphasizes identifying and working with unusual plants.
selected_references.inference: Portal, pen, and progress labels must be separated and anchored to visible objects.

anti_pattern.observation: The baseline relied on many flat rectangular world blocks, fixed five-flower stacks, and labels sharing the same visual band as progress feedback.
anti_pattern.lesson: Use compact organic silhouettes, deterministic variation, one active route, and separate HUD bands; do not solve readability by adding more text or unbounded nodes.

official_docs.verified_constraint: GUI node creation, text, boxes, and runtime node-count considerations.
Pie nodes can provide organic ellipse silhouettes with perimeter control.
GUI text nodes support runtime text updates and scaling.
Sound components can be played by URL-hash and gated through the master group.
Texture/atlas choices affect draw calls and bundle budget; code-native geometry avoids a large art payload.

alternatives.reason: Keeps the existing wandering problem and makes route intent difficult to read.
Would replace the restorative movement verb, add failure-state complexity, and increase art/audio scope.
Small deterministic zones, ordered route checkpoints, readable pens, low-stakes pests, and additive Honey sinks fit the existing architecture.
